data.name: Three Wishes
data.detailed_description:
FEATURES AND GAMEPLAY OVERVIEW

Have you ever wondered what the little sisters of famous idols get up to in their free time? Find out in this revolutionary visual novel full of headpats, plot twists, and silly hijinks!

In Three Wishes, players make choices to determine what wishes the girls make. Each wish compounds on the previous and leads to crazy outcomes. Finishing the entire game takes around 3-4 hours.

  • Headpats Engine: Interact with all characters on screen at any time by headpatting them with dynamic physics!

  • Props & Effects: Each route is packed with various props that characters interact with and visual effects that keep things interesting!

  • Quips System: Characters react in real-time to dialogue and events taking place!

HEADPATS ENGINE

Years of engineering, millions of dollars of funding, and recent breakthroughs in quantum technology have allowed our team of top-notch developers (me) to craft something truly special. I proudly present: The Headpats Engine!

Characters are fully dynamic and can be interacted with at pretty much any time during gameplay. Feeling down? headpat. Hungry? Give a headpat. Broken leg? Might I suggest headpats?

Headpatting the characters will play a major part in the game! Thank you to everyone who made this incredible technology possible.

PROPS & EFFECTS

Have you ever felt yourself getting a little too cozy while playing a visual novel? All those words, relaxing you, making you feel comfy and safe and secure. Well, you won't find that here! Three Wishes is all about the Props & Effects!

Millions of hours of painstaking labor helped us reach this point. I kept saying this to myself while developing the game: "Hey, this scene is finally done. But what if it wasn't?", and then I stuffed even more props into the scene. Sure, those 50 plush toys could be mentioned off-camera, but what if I simply added them to the game with some art? The girls turn into candy this route? Surely the developer will not painstakingly redraw every single sprite for just 100 lines of dialogue hahaha... Think again!!

My blood, sweat, tears, and years of my life went into stuffing this game full of stuff people will forget after 5 seconds and I couldn't be more happy.

QUIPS SYSTEM

Do you hate silly pointless lines of dialogue in visual novels? Me neither! So I toiled endlessly pondering how I could stuff even more dialogue on screen so even the dialogue can have dialogue. After extensive testing, I arrived at a technology that will revolutionize visual novels! I call it: The Quips System!

With this unprecedented technology, characters can now be implied to be saying small lines of dialogue (quips, if you will) in reaction to the main lines of dialogue. They can also react to other characters or show off their internal dialogue. It opens up a lot of possibility for new interaction!

I expect this system to fundamentally change the visual novel landscape within the next 5-10 years and couldn't be happier to finally bring it to the public.

STORY, CHARACTERS, & GAMEPLAY

Addie, Mint, and Emi are on their way to a sleepover when a shooting star falls from the sky and crashes right near them! Saty appears, promising to grant them whatever their hearts desire. The catch? She will only grant Three Wishes! (heh)

Get an up close and personal peek into the lives of the eccentric Lilpads and others!

  • Addie is Lily's airheaded but always energetic little sister!

  • Mint is Nym's sadistic and genius level intellect little sister!

  • Emi is Vicky's depressed yet still hopeful little sister!

  • Saty is a mysterious girl who fell from the sky and claims she can grant wishes!

The player influences the decisions the girls make when wishing. Guide the girls as they wish for whatever their hearts desire! Each wish will lead to more wild outcomes. Can you help them make the perfect wish? Over 12 endings to experience!

SOUNDTRACK

Fully original soundtrack by Vect (@VectressWasHere on YouTube)! Over 20 unique songs to feast your ears upon. Each track masterfully crafted!! Vect is amazing. Actually, the music kinda carries the game to be honest. Everybody say "Thaaank yoooou, Veeeect~".

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE (POSSIBLE SPOILERS BELOW THIS POINT)

I really tried to push the boundary of what people think a visual novel can be by adding lots of weird and experimental features! I expect some may not mesh so well with the genre, but I couldn't help myself. I hope you enjoy :D

Three Wishes is a visual novel based in the Lilypad Lily world. It's not necessary to have played the other games to play this one, but it'd probably make stuff funnier and some stuff might make more sense, particularly references to "Lily". Or you might go "Hey I know that character, haha." one or two times if you've played the other games.

The Steam assets illustration was made by Soyacomu (Soyatu). No AI was used in the making of this game.

There is nothing lewd in this game. There are some scenes that some players may find disturbing. There is depiction of cartoon blood, death, and occasionally young people being happy.

data.short_description: Ever wonder what the little sisters of famous idols get up to in their free time? Get ready for an adventure full of headpats and wish-driven insanity! Discover 12+ endings in this visual novel that pushes the genre beyond its limits.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Portuguese - Portugal*, French*
*languages with full audio support
data.reviews:
“...I think all of the routes are genuinely freaking hilarious. And I think that's a big important thing. I think that's one of the hardest things to do, is make a funny video game...and I think that Kyuppin has done this miraculously three times in a row.”
Sockscast Episode 175 – The Sockscast

“Repeated uses of "WHAT? WHAT THE F***?" as you uncover just the most insane gonzo scenarios a creative mind can come up with.”
Visual Novels of the Year 2025 – Frezno's Raving Rants
